title: Pitch Contractors a Mobile Demo of Their Own Site
summary: Find trades with weak websites, rebuild one as a polished mobile demo from their own site, and pitch the rebuild with the audit in hand.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes you can build and host simple sites; the value is rebuilds and care plans you sell.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You sell site rebuilds and care plans to local trades.
A demo of their own business opens the conversation.
who_its_for: Freelancers who serve roofers, HVAC and plumbing companies.

stack.name: Lead Scout
stack.role: Finds local businesses whose sites show search gaps.
stack.creator: itsryanlenk

stack.name: WebsiteAudit
stack.role: Runs a website audit and explains the top issues in plain words.
stack.creator: websiteaudit_20261003

stack.name: Web Bot
stack.role: Rebuilds a contractor's old site as a polished multi-page demo.
stack.creator: Mr Clean

outputs: A demo site ready to pitch

steps: Pick one trade and one city.
Find businesses with weak sites and audit the best ten.
Build a demo for the strongest prospects.
Send the pitch yourself with the audit and the demo link.
guardrails: Do not publish a demo with a business's name, photos or text without permission.
Check local rules on cold outreach.
